# SipWhey

Strength Meets Radiance. SipWhey is a premium clear protein drink — 20g whey protein isolate + 5g hydrolyzed marine collagen, 24.5g total protein per serving, with Vitamin C and no added sugar. Clear, light and refreshing — protein for your active life, wellness for everything else.

## Flavours
- Tropical Pineapple
- Wild Blueberry

## Offers
- Single Box (7 single-serving sachets): launch price ₹1,599 (MRP ₹1,999)
- SipWhey Duo (2 boxes, 14 sachets): ₹2,999

## On this page
- Why SipWhey is different from a traditional protein shake (clear, not milky)
- The dual-protein formula explained
- The daily ritual: tear, mix, chill, sip
- Flavour experience and purchase options
